title: cerastium fontanum f. holosteoides
intro: Cerastium fontanum f. holosteoides, commonly known as Sticky Mouse-ear Chickweed, is a subspecies of the Cerastium fontanum plant, which is a flowering perennial herb in the carnation family. It is used in traditional medicine due to its various health benefits, including its anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antiseptic properties, which can aid in wound healing and the treatment of skin conditions. The therapeutic actions of Sticky Mouse-ear Chickweed include its ability to soothe and calm irritated skin, reduce inflammation, and promote the healing process. The bioactive constituents of Cerastium fontanum f. holosteoides include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and other compounds that contribute to its medicinal properties.
